name: whatbreaks
description: Risk review for Terraform and OpenTofu plans: what an apply will destroy, replace, expose, or weaken, ranked by severity with a fix for each finding. In Claude Code and Cowork an apply gate blocks terraform apply until the exact plan file has been reviewed.

apply_gate.title: Block terraform apply until the plan is reviewed
apply_gate.description: When on, a hook denies terraform, tofu, and terragrunt apply/destroy in Claude Code and Cowork until the exact plan file has been reviewed with /whatbreaks:review (or approved with /whatbreaks:approve after a BLOCK verdict). Turn off to keep only the review skills.
